So definitely expect a wait even if there are a handful of people in the restaurant. As for the food, I got the pastrami, and brisket combo. The pastrami was honestly super underwhelming. Yes it was relatively juicy, and decently flavorful, the texture…

Katz's has been open since 1888 and it shows in the best possible way. The walls are covered in celebrity photos going back decades, the staff have clearly been here a while, and when you walk in you get handed a paper ticket that you're told very firmly not to lose. The ordering system is a little chaotic by modern standards, separate counters for sandwiches, sides, and drinks, but once you figure out the flow…

I knew this place was going to be busy, but actually being inside is a different experience. It has that old New York feeling where everything is moving at once, people are talking, orders are being called out, and somehow everyone still gets their food. I ordered the pastrami sandwich, matzo ball soup, potato latkes, and a black and white cookie. The pastrami sandwich is definitely the main event. The meat is piled…

Everything tasted good but my company and I didn’t feel well after eating (diarrhea, thus 3 stars), maybe it’s too heavy and we had too much food in the past few days. rv.t: I stopped here for a swim after a hot day exploring Annecy. The beach was clean, lots of people, beautiful water and lifeguards were on duty. The public toilets are free, but they are a disaster..but there are 2 changing rooms right next door and they are great. It was a nice way to cool off in this heat! ☀️ (Wear water shoes if you have them, there are rocks here!)

visited Plage des Marquisats during a day trip from Lyon, and it was a highlight of my visit to Annecy. The beach is easily accessible by foot from the town center, making it a stress-free walk along the lake. It is a beautiful, peaceful place that offers a much calmer vibe than the busier tourist areas nearby. The water is incredibly clear, and the mountain views are unbeatable. Highly recommend if you’re looking…

Beautiful spotless swimming area. We found a nice shaded area on a grassy bank next to the lifeguard station, toilette and showers. Designated swimming areas for babies, young children and adults. Swim shoes recommend as it’s pretty rocky walking into the water and then turns to a weird clay/mud base. Water was lovely and the scenery is spectacular.

Our friends were getting married in Oaxaca and we were there also another…

Chocolate cake was good, flan was not jelly like but instead like a cake and the panque de elote was my favorite. Staff was helpful the atmosphere is nice. The restaurant was empty on Sunday 8 pm.

Our waiter, Alan, was excellent. Very attentive and pleasant. The whole meal which for us consisted of several the share plates was beautiful in both taste and presentation. We will always come back whenever we are in Oaxaca.

Every corner tells a story: hand-painted talavera tiles, textiles woven by the country's top artisans, and carefully curated folk art that gave the space so much soul. You can tell the…

Hotel staff contacted me as soon as they found it. I was 6 hours away, they arranged (for a fee) that passport and cash was delivered to me in a few hours. Exceptional service. 1952.ed: People say this canal offers beautiful scenery, especially with its historic stone warehouses and gas lamps. Visitors highlight that it's a great place for a leisurely stroll, with many nearby shops and restaurants. They also mention that the canal cruise is a special experience, providing insights into Otaru's history.
1952.edj: クチコミによると、小樽運河は特に歴史ある石造りの倉庫群やガス灯が美しく、景色が良いと評判です。多くの人が、運河沿いの散策を楽しんでおり、近くにはたくさんの店やレストランがあることも魅力として挙げられています。また、運河クルーズは小樽の歴史を知る特別な体験ができるという声もあります。

rv.t: Otaru Canal One of Otaru's most iconic landmarks and a must-visit photo spot for anyone visiting the city. I visited in late May during the evening, and the atmosphere was incredibly relaxing. It was a great place to take a leisurely stroll, sit by the canal, and watch sightseeing boats slowly pass by. When the water is calm, the historic warehouse buildings lining the canal are beautifully reflected on the surface…

A visit to Otaru wouldn't be complete without a stroll along the famous Otaru Canal. Even in summer, the canal retains its charm. Under the sunshine, the historic stone warehouses, calm water, and reflections looked almost like a painting. Beyond its beauty, the canal offers a glimpse into Otaru's past as one of Hokkaido's most important port cities. It's easy to see why this area has become a symbol of the city…

Otaru Canal is one of Hokkaido's most iconic winter destinations, and for good reason. The historic stone warehouses, dusted with snow and lined with glistening icicles, create a romantic, old-world atmosphere that feels like stepping into a vintage postcard. The calm water reflects the heritage buildings and soft winter light beautifully—it's genuinely stunning and absolutely worth the visit. ⚠️ Important Winter…

Cars cannot come in so bring a lighter luggage and also because there is no lift in the hotel. Breakfast is basic. However service was good. I was offered a 500 yen voucher as I did not want cleaning and I used it at the bar which served very good cocktail. There is a foot bath in the lobby as…

I chose a room with private onsen so I can use it anytime of the day and it was perfect for me , close to the main attraction and bus station. Many good local cafe and restaurant especially soba

rv.t: The hotel is locates in a quiet and peaceful area, they have an incredible Nikai beach on a site. There is also a decent swimming pool. Staff were really attentive and helpful all the time. Breakfast and lunch were top notch with good variety of options available. Parking is free for the guests so you can enjoy short trips around. There is also Gala in 10 min walk (2 min drive) where you can find little souvenir…

Wish we had paid more to stay elsewhere.||Appears to be no investment in the hotel for many years/decades. Some things that really let it down:|- extremely hard beds |-1970’s bathroom|- no porter service for luggage - you take a trolley yourself|-no bar open after 6pm|- breakfast queues so bad you ‘take a ticket’|-…

rv.t: Super fun dinning experience with great service, food and drinks on the rooftop. They serve Asahi Super Dry as a draft beer, some other imported beers and tasty cocktails. Mr. Isshy, the restaurant manager, gave us the interesting story about his operation while grilling our food. This year’s theme is “Mexicana” He grilled everything so good and we really enjoyed everything! We had such a great time! I wish Isshy…

【このお値段でこのボリュームとお肉の質に美味しさに驚く、お野菜もたっぷりのメキシカン・ビアガーデン】 東京の中心地、松屋銀座の屋上に、夏だけの特別な楽園が現れます。 2026年のテーマは”A Touch of Mexican Spirit”。 ビビッドな色彩とラテンの音色に包まれながら、 自由で陽気なひとときを過ごせるビアガーデンに行きました🍽️ お野菜もたっぷりで 飲み放題でいただけるカクテルもオシャレで 女性にも嬉しいコースが7,700円と 行きやすくて大注目です♡ →なのにお肉はジューシーでボリューミーなので 私は女子会で行きましたが、男性も満足できそうです！ ―――――――――― ✅本場メキシコの空気を纏う装いの中、国産牛サーロインや日本橋・日山の豚もも、銀座・牛蔵の若鶏など。産地にこだわったお肉を自らの手で炙り上げるライブ感あふれる体験…

松屋銀座の屋上テラスにある「美しくなるビアガーデン」に行ってきました。 飲み放題とBBQがセットで8,000円。少し高めの価格設定ですが、雰囲気や料理の内容を考えると十分満足できました。 BBQは豚・鶏・牛と種類が豊富で、どのお肉も食べ応えがあります。特に牛肉はジューシーで、ビールとの相性抜群でした。テラス席なので開放感があり、銀座の夜景を眺めながら過ごせるのも魅力です。 おしゃれな雰囲気で女子会やデートにもおすすめのビアガーデンです。

1958.edj: クチコミでは、この牧場直営店が提供するソフトクリームについて、「濃厚で美味しい」「なめらかで口当たりが良い」「後味がさっぱりしている」と高く評価されています。特に、ボリューム満点の「大」サイズを挙げる人が多く、その量に満足しているという声が目立ちます。また、スタッフの対応が「親切」「感じが良い」というクチコミや、道路を挟んだ向かい側にいる牛やヤギを見られることを楽しむ人もいます。駐車場が広く利用しやすい点や、ヨーグルトやプリンなどの乳製品も販売されている点も、訪れた人から好評を得ています。

rv.t: Soft and fresh. One of the best ice cream . Can visit the cows to appreciate the milk used better. Not sure if the source is from across. I walked from Sakura Jr station after a stroll around the castle ruins and Japanese History Museum.
One of the best ice creams we ever had! Must try! We got the large soft cream in cup. The ice cream seemed so fresh and delicious with a rich creamy milk flavor.
I had pudding and blueberry yogurt (¥550 for each). Both tasted amazing. Next to this place, the cute goat was chilling.

rv.t: 祖師谷大蔵の「鳥バル陽（haru）」さん、これは本当にいいお店でした。鹿児島出身のオーナーさんがやられているお店で、鹿児島ならではの鶏料理をしっかり味わえるのが魅力です。 まず感動したのが鳥刺し。鮮度が命の一品ですが、表面の食感とねっとりした旨み、臭みのなさが見事で、九州ならではの甘口醤油との相性も抜群でした。関東でこのクオリティの鳥刺しを出せるお店はそうそうありません。さらに水炊きも絶品で、鶏の旨みがしっかり溶け込んだスープが体に染みわたり、ぷりっとした鶏肉も食べ応え十分。〆まで余すことなく楽しめました。 鹿児島出身のオーナーさんの人柄もあって居心地がよく、鶏好き・九州料理好きにはたまらない一軒。祖師谷大蔵でいいお店を探しているなら、鳥バル陽は間違いなくおすすめです。鳥刺しと水炊き目当てに、必ずまた伺います。リピート確定です。
新入社員の歓迎会にて利用させて頂きました！ 何度も行ったことあり、安定の美味しさです！ 写真を撮り忘れてしまいましたが、【鶏刺し】は絶品です☺️ 再訪した時に、 【鶏刺し】もちゃんと写真が撮れました☺️
鹿児島出身の店主に、薩摩の創作料理や鳥、焼酎を堪能できる居酒屋さん。気さくな店員に美味い料理。 是非カウンターで鹿児島へお帰りください。 ただいま、そんな雰囲気のお店です。

Visitors mention the lively atmosphere and that it's a great place for families and…
1960.edj: 店内に設置された生け簀から自ら釣った魚を希望の調理法で料理して提供する。刺身盛り合わせや一品料理など通常メニューも用意している。

rv.t: A very fun experience and very lovely staff! The fishing was awesome and using bait made it very easy for anyone to try! The staff help you take pictures after you catch the fish or will beat a drum in celebration for you! Breaded and tempura were by far my favorite style to have the fish cooked and the French fries were like homefries but absolutely delicious. Definitely recommend and would come again!!

this restaurant is so much fun! we were able to fish for our own meal here at zauo. the waitress was super kind, attentive, and patient as we tried to do our best to catch a fish. we were able to pick how the fish would be served: all sashimi, all fried, or half and half. we went with half and half for our first fish and both were amazing, especially the presentation for the sashimi. this was such a unique way to…

Food is pretty good for a themed restaurant albeit more expensive than comparable Izakaya, but at least the fish is very fresh and tasty. But the service was excellent, especially for our server, Miyu. She made our night with very attentive service, cheerful personality (which is rare in Japan in the service industry) and just all around great spirit. She made sure we had a memorable dinner the night before we fly…

Visitors appreciate the attentive staff, pet-friendly options, and the overall relaxing atmosphere.
1962.edj: この宿泊施設を利用した人は、素晴らしいオーシャンビューと、ビーチへ直接アクセスできる点を高く評価しています。部屋によってはプライベートサウナやジャグジーが備わっているというクチコミもあります。また、新鮮な地元の魚介類を使った美味しい部屋食や、無料のドリンクや軽食も好評です。スタッフのきめ細やかな対応、ペット同伴可能なオプション、そして全体的にリラックスできる雰囲気も、訪れた人々に喜ばれています。

rv.t: Came here with my family with two young kids. It was a nice little time away from the city. Not much going on outside the room, but the meals in the room were a lot of fun. Dinner and breakfast included. All in all it was a solid stay.

It was an amazing staying. The food, the ocean view, and the hospitality were all top. I stayed here for 3 days and 2 nights. What impressed me most was the hospitality of the staff. The foreign staff were fluent and attentive, which made for a relaxing stay. Every meal changed and we were able to enjoy ingredients such as abalone and locally grown vegetables. All of Chef Kyomasu's dishes were delicious. There are…

Absolutely a great place for a weekend getaways. Quite and refreshing. Great build containers home with Japanese signature interior setup. The parking lot is about 100 meters away from the place. Here are what we like about this place; free beverages from the fridge. VERY comfortable and good size bed. Fantastic sea view. The downsides are; Its a bit pricey, Food aren't the best, and worst of all is the checkout…

They also highlight the reasonable prices and the staff's polite and efficient service. 1963.edj: この伝統的な和菓子店を訪れた人は、季節限定のよもぎ餅をはじめとする美味しい餅菓子や、すあま、赤飯などの和菓子を高く評価しています。手頃な価格設定や、スタッフの丁寧で効率的なサービスも好評のようです。また、歴史を感じさせる店の雰囲気や、ICカードやPayPayなど多様な支払い方法が利用できる利便性も、訪れた人々に喜ばれています。

rv.t: Very tasty mochi and sweets, prices are normal, but the taste is way better than in most other sweet shops. They also sell more than mochi, we bought small star shaped sweets made of sugar and colouring, it was tasty too

Old lady sells most delicious mochi and another traditional sweets, well balanced taste of sticky rice and sweet bean paste. Highly recommended. Traditional mochi Hayes of several generation is an excellent local experience ❤️

I decided to visit “Chikara Mochiya,” a long-established Japanese sweets shop with a history of over 300 years spanning nine generations since the Edo period. Heading south from Kotoku-in and crossing the railroad crossing next to Enoden’s Hase Station, I could feel the damp, humid sea breeze that hinted at the nearby ocean. “Chikara Mochiya” was about a five-minute walk from the crossing. I was able to enjoy some…

1964.ed: Diners like this teppanyaki restaurant's delicious and high-quality offerings, especially the steak and abalone, prepared with skill and precision right in front of them. They also highlight the elegant, artistic, and luxurious atmosphere, which creates a special, non-ordinary experience. Guests mention the attentive and warm service, with staff providing detailed explanations and thoughtful care…
1964.edj: 落ち着きのあるレトロモダンな内装の店内には、鉄板カウンター席や個室も完備。黒毛和牛などの鉄板焼きをコースで提供している。

rv.t: Absolutely a place to enjoy Japanese teppanyaki. The atmosphere is full of artistic declarations especially if you’re a crystal lover. Old Lalique & magnificent cutleries! The chief serving us was so skillful & explaining so well about the ingredients in details. Superb & attentive service! Overall the food was delicious & tasty from the appetizers to the desert. This was my third time to have dinning here when…

We heard they served Kobe Beef and figured this would be a nice first spot to try out one of the "must try" foods in Japan. We grabbed I believe their most expensive course dinner and everything was fantastic. While some of the food items are a little tough for foreigners like us that aren't used to it (abalone), overall our dinner was great and it was a fantastic way of introducing us to luxury Japanese cuisine. A…

My birthday dinner at Ginza Ukai-Tei was truly beyond words and one of the most memorable dining experiences of my life. From the moment I arrived, I was treated with a level of hospitality and attention to detail that left me completely speechless. Celebrating my birthday in Tokyo was already a dream come true, but the team at Ginza Ukai-Tei elevated the evening into something extraordinary. A special thank you to…

Once you get to the top, you will probably be gassed out but the view is great! Definitely worth it. If you have watched AOT, you will notice a lot of references fans have left in the building, I even took a picture at the top with the scout cape on LOL
Very nice view over the town and the crater rim, and a nice walk on the town wall.

Great view in the fresh air to reward you after a long steep climb. Stairway is narrow, but there are some passing places. The viewing area at the top is also very narrow. It is hard to pass people, so you have to go at the same pace as everyone else as you circumnavigate the tower. Pay station is just below the top and the attendant has EFTPOS and cash change facilities.

Another tower within the medieval walls of Nordlingen. This tower also contains a museum which we didn't visit as we wanted to walk the whole circumference of the walled city. An awesome walk suggested by the Wife and worth it.
Sick models and armor, if you like AOT then you’ll like the top floor.

1967.a: Hoshino Resorts KAI Kaga, １８-47 Yamashiroonsen, Kaga, Ishikawa 922-0242, Japan
1967.aj: 〒922-0242 石川県加賀市山代温泉１８−４７ 界 加賀

rv.t: Regardless, we proactively requested not to prefer to eat beef for religious reasons. However, I was still informed that the hotel policy cannot make any adjustments for anyone. What a joke that you can have more rice! Is this a policy for human beings? Another interesting fact to note is that there is no additional food order option, even if you want to select food options, as long as you are willing to pay for…

"Underwhelming" is the one word I'd use to describe the overall stay. For a Hoshino Resorts KAI property, we had higher expectations than the experience provided. The food was passable, but nothing memorable. The room was the highlight with tasteful touches and a private outdoor tub. But it was the service that was the real shame, or rather dependent on staff members. When we first arrived at the hotel, it was…

One of the best hotels we’ve been to in Japan. Beautiful rooms, great service. The hotel is mostly catered to Japanese guests, but there was always someone who could speak English. The room was beautiful, Japanese style. Very large with beautiful south facing balcony. The food (dinner and breakfast) was excellent - bib gourmand level. We informed them ahead of time that one of us has vegetarian diet restrictions…

1968.a: Habushiura Coast, Namure, Niijima, Tokyo 100-0400, Japan
1968.aj: 〒100-0400 東京都新島村ナムレ羽伏浦海岸
1968.ed: Swimming beach along half of island's east coast with clear water, horizon view & Moai-like statue.
1968.edj: 島の東岸の半分に沿った海水浴場で、水は透明で水平線が見え、モアイのような彫像がある。

rv.t: The beach is long and wide. It is a magnificent view with turquoise waters. Surfer love it. Not ideal though for swimming and sunbathing due to high waves, strong current, and somewhat "rough" sand.

Beautiful beach, nice turquoise waters. But beware, on windy days, this beach can turn into a sandstorm nightmare just like it did for me. I was hoping to run my 10km along the vast beach, until I got badly surprised by repetitive batches of sandstorms l, stuck between the cliff and the big waves, so nowhere to go but straight into the clouds of sands. They were so painful it felt like an attack of bees stinging you…
Beautiful but you can’t swim

rv.t: Best place to watch the sunset in Niijima island. Getting there can take around 10-15 minutes from the beach. Make sure to check the sunset timing as It's worth the trouble.
Great view over the island. walking up takes around 45 Minutes. Good place for picnic.
The walk up is on a concrete road but like any other place on this island the view is spectacular, especially on a sunny day!

It is located in a really nice neighborhood, carries amazing culture and food from all around the world, and is highly accessible by tram. A must-visit!

This is a beautiful and creative spot but unfortunately the massive construction/repair project that is underway on the VIADUCT is having a very negative effect on the stores in the area. Many appear to be closing. However, the restaurants don't seem to be impacted in the same way but several of the retailers I chatted with indicated it has been disastrous for their business. The construction is not scheduled to be…
Modern food hall in the industry quarter with Sushi, Swiss cheese, pasta, Thai, and a bakery amongst other.

rv.t: 成城石井東京駅一番街店さんは東京駅直結の便利な立地にある店舗で、朝早くから夜まで営業しているため移動の合間にも立ち寄りやすいお店です。新幹線利用前後にも使いやすい場所にあります。 店内はそれほど大きくはありませんが、惣菜や弁当、デザート、輸入食品などがしっかり揃っており、短時間でも効率よく買い物ができる印象でした。 東京駅という場所柄やや混雑していることもありますが、質の高い商品がコンパクトにまとまっているので使い勝手は良いです。ちょっとした食事やお土産にも便利な店舗でした。
2026/07/09:到常去的超級市場或是路邊水果攤，今年暑假來竟然都看不到我最愛的桃子和抹茶冰淇淋，不小心看到這邊竟然有水蜜桃。立刻殺進來。
お惣菜やおかず類など、持ち帰り用のグッズ売り場が大部分を占めています。電車内で食べるような商品というよりは、家庭用のおかず向けの品揃えです。そのため、通勤で頻繁に利用する方には便利ですが、新幹線など旅のお供としてはやや不向きに感じました。 一方で、乾き物はそこそこ種類があり、おつまみの選択肢は豊富です。

1972.a: Japan, 〒100-0005 Tokyo, Chiyoda City, Marunouchi, 1 Chome−9−1 Sendai Tanya Rikyu Tokyo Station Gransta Yaesu Branch, グランスタ八重洲B1
1972.aj: 〒100-0005 東京都千代田区丸の内１丁目９−１ 仙臺たんや 利久 東京駅グランスタ八重洲店 グランスタ八重洲B1

1972.edj: シンプルな店内にはカウンター席も有り。手作りにこだわった絶賛された牛タンメニューがカジュアルに頂ける。

rv.t: Rikyu Tokyoekiten — stumbled across this ox tongue restaurant while looping around Tokyo Station and decided to give it a try. Ended up being a strong first stop. The ox tongue here is thinner and more tender than what I’ve had at BBQ places. Instead of being charred and crispy, it’s cooked evenly to the chef’s recommendation, which gave me a better appreciation of how locals enjoy it. We ordered the deluxe set to…

Excellent beef bowl set lunch. Beef was extremely succulent and well grilled! Didn’t need much effort to chew! Greens were fresh and a much needed palette cleanser. I also ordered a small portion of beef tongue which is their speciality. It’s my first time having beef tongue and this wasn’t as tender as I had expected. Located conveniently amongst a whole array of restaurants at the basement of Tokyo station…

It is outside the ticket gate but the location was a little hard to find. Included the map of Gransta to help. I found the place by asking directions for Starbucks which was close by and went from there. Ordered the grilled beef tongue, absolutely delicious. The set came with a salad, fish cake appetiser, oxtail soup, barley rice, entree, and a delightful mochi ball as dessert. I understand that they switch them up…

rv.t: This is hands-down my favorite spot in Tokyo. NEGISHI delivers an unforgettable dining experience no matter where you are in the city. It's not a budget spot or overly extravagant—just that perfect balance that guarantees satisfaction every time. Whether you're a local or just passing…
I wasnt a big beef tongue fan in the past but this place convinced my the otherwise. I ordered a thin beef tongue set. It is not hard to chew and the gravy is irresistible. Rice is refillable.

Great place for a quick beef tongue lunch. The soup is excellent and the food comes out really quick. It can get pretty crowded at lunch time. They don't speak much English here, but you can always point at pictures.

If you like antiques, this shop has plenty to offer.
椅子が大量にあります。その他テーブル、シェルフ等の大きめの家具が中心です。絵がひっそり結構安く売られている印象でした。

This place could possibly ruin your appetites. Services were the worst you can get in a touristy place. Young and arrogant can only bring you thus far. My wish for every person who works here in this shop to have karmas as being customers themselves whom you have treated rudely to (for heaven knows), so that you can experience and understand their feelings. To be honest, the okonomiyaki was just average, the bottom…
Found it by chance and loved it! A small place, with great okonomiyaki. There was no cue, so we directly entered. Paid 3700yen for two okonomiyaki and one high ball.

rv.t: ​草津温泉の西側に位置する再開発エリアで、伝統とモダンが融合した落ち着いた雰囲気があります。 ​地蔵の湯や約1万冊の漫画を読める静かなカフェスペース漫画堂、​百年石別館などがあります。 ​展望デッキは夜はライトアップされます。湯畑の喧騒を離れ、幻想的な散策を楽しめます。
一個幽靜的景點，覺起來很舒適 不知道為什麼地藏有毛衣好可愛，然後顏湯不知道為什麼聞起來有個羅漢果的味道，香香的
裏草津マンガ堂付近の通りの様子。 このような散策路が整備されていますが結局は足湯やショップぐらいしかない。 日帰りの方には重宝でも、宿泊客にはそれほど魅力的ではない。

1977.a: Oike Spring, Shonaicho Asono, Yufu, Oita 879-5423, Japan
1977.aj: 〒879-5423 大分県由布市庄内町阿蘇野男池湧水群
1977.ed: Visitors say this natural spring features incredibly clear, beautiful spring water and a serene, mystical old-growth forest that offers a refreshing escape. They also highlight the well-maintained walking paths, making it accessible for all ages, and the option to collect the delicious spring water. Guests mention the affordable 100-yen entrance fee and the presence of clean restrooms and ample…
1977.edj: この自然豊かな湧水地を訪れた人は、信じられないほど澄んだ美しい湧き水と、神秘的な原生林がもたらす清々しさを高く評価しています。整備された遊歩道はあらゆる年齢層にとって歩きやすく、美味しい湧き水を汲んで持ち帰ることができる点も好評です。また、入場料が100円と手頃で、清潔なトイレと十分な無料駐車場があることもクチコミで言及されています。

rv.t: We were on our way to yufuin and decided to take a detour and it was absolutely worth it. It costs 100 yen per person to enter (to contribute to keeping the area clean) and it was a lovely wander around a beautiful forest. It looks like it is also a starting point to hike up the mountain, but if you just want a leisurely walk, it will take about 15mins and it's very flat and walkable to any abled person, routes are…
Such a serene place! The water at Oike Spring is incredibly clear, and the surrounding nature makes it very relaxing.

The actual pond has amazing clear water bubbling up constantly from underneath within the rocks. Bring your water bottle and fill up! What's even more impressive about this place is the forest walk you take up over a hill and through an old forest to reach the pond.

super cute café:))

I had Anko & cream cheese crepe topped with Shinsyu Sweet ice cream, plus a set coffee. The ice cream was very rich. The cream cheese was also rich and buttery. The black sesame added a nice accent. Personally, I would have liked the anko to stand out a bit more. Surprisingly, the set coffee was also very good for me.

The coffee jelly was perfect. The ice cream had a very silky texture, and the sweetness was well balanced. The café wasn’t crowded, and the food and drinks took around 15–20 minutes to prepare. The wait was a little longer than expected, but everything was freshly made.
